title: Architecture Tests Runner Config
description: Binds architecture contracts to the adapter that enforces them and the target sources they govern. Scaffolded to schemas/ on init (no-overwrite); the runner (Invoke-ArchTests.ps1) reads a config validated against this schema.

checks.description: One entry per contract to enforce.

contractId.description: Stable id of the architecture contract this check enforces. Also derives the receipt filename, so it must be path-safe.

adapter.description: Enforcement backend. Deterministic adapters hard-gate; semantic-eval is advisory.

maturity.description: Contract maturity. 'locked' hard-gates (only a real pass greens); 'draft'/'provisional' warn on non-pass. Defaults to 'draft' when omitted.

contractPath.description: Path to the human-owned contract definition. Folded into the freshness hash so editing the contract invalidates prior receipts.

testProject.description: Path to the human-owned, reviewed test project/spec the adapter executes (deterministic adapters).

spec.description: Path to the adapter spec file (e.g. ts-arch/dependency-cruiser spec).

targets.description: Target source paths/globs whose tree/content hash freshness binds to.

provider.description: Semantic-eval provider name (required when adapter=semantic-eval). One of: custom, mock, null, waza.

credentialTarget.description: Optional dedicated Windows Credential Manager target the semantic-eval provider reads its LLM token from. Isolated from the plugin eval harness credential; skip-not-error when unset or missing.
